description:
RELICTRA@26 passionate team of young innovators exploring the forgotten stories of space exploration. We aim to rediscover the legacy of past space missions, understand the achievements of historic spacecraft and rovers, and bring their stories back to life through creativity and technology. We believe every mission has a story worth remembering, and every discovery inspires the future.

Our motto: Every mission leaves a story.
summary: Still Here (RELICTRA@26): An interactive web experience that turns NASA spacecraft left on the Moon, Mars and deep space into stories, not "space junk." Visitors explore 11 relics across 3 worlds, each with a signal status (Silent, Resting or Still Calling). A short quiz and a printable Mars lesson for ages 10–14 bring the stories into classrooms.
details:
Still Here – Exploring the Stories of NASA's Space Relics

Still Here is an interactive educational web platform that brings the forgotten stories of NASA's spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific instruments back to life. It explores 11 historic space relics across the Moon, Mars, and deep space, helping users understand their missions, scientific discoveries, and current status.

Rather than considering these machines as space junk, the platform presents them as valuable milestones in human space exploration. Through interactive storytelling, mission details, signal-status classifications, search features, and engaging quizzes, users can discover how these machines contributed to our understanding of the universe.

The platform also includes educational resources and classroom activities to make space science more accessible to students, teachers, and space enthusiasts.

Our vision: To transform forgotten space missions into inspiring stories of human curiosity, innovation, and discovery.

Still Here – Not abandoned. Retired, remembered, and still teaching.
